create_escher_agent: create an ESCHER agent for a game using escher.Agent with escher.Config
build_train_config: build an escher.TrainConfig with iterations, evaluation_interval, and nashconv settings
run_escher_training: run escher.train to train an ESCHER agent on a game
test_nash_conv: test the trained agent by computing nash_conv with pyspiel.nash_conv
summarize_policy_values: summarize policy values using expected_game_score.policy_value for the average policy
